contract: Three distant byte ranges within an owned resource, each a complete independently decodable copy of the existing generated2second H264/AAC movie. Compare three concurrent ordinary requests (cheapest correct baseline) with one multipart request, all receiving15ms per-request server delay. Parse exact Content-Range/body boundaries and reject truncation; all extracted movies must equal independent source bytes.
sampling: Eleven alternating pairs over same HTTP origin, shared connection pool; complete fetch/body parsing/output gather measured. Fixture setup common to both.
threshold: 95% bootstrap lower bound of paired latency saving must exceed5%; otherwise no worthwhile latency benefit for this local parallel-range workload. Request-count and response-byte differences are reported separately.
